namesti3.prompt: Wide painted background illustration: the market square of a Bohemian town at dusk, a tall Gothic town hall with a great astronomical clock and slender twin spires rising behind it, gabled burgher houses with steep roofs, a stone fountain in the middle distance, market stalls under canvas. Down both sides of the square hang rows of tall PLAIN crimson banners on timber crossbars — deep red cloth with a narrow gold embroidered border and absolutely nothing on it, no emblem, no crest, no animal, no writing, just empty red fabric with soft folds. Iron braziers and hanging lanterns burn warm orange, cobblestones wet with rain. The centre of the picture is calm open sky and haze, the detail sits at the left and right edges and in the lower corners. Painted concept art in the style of the Age of Empires II Definitive Edition main menu artwork, oil painting brushwork, warm light against a cold violet and indigo twilight sky, deep shadows at the picture edges, no text, no user interface
